<JS Skill Enable> 
  var activeMinions = $gameTroop.members().filter(function (e) {
    return e.isEnemy() && e._isMinionEsporo && e.isAlive();
  }); 
  enabled = activeMinions.length < 4;
</JS Skill Enable>

<JS Post-Apply>
  // Procura por minions ESPORO mortos (não ocultos)
  var deadMinions = $gameTroop.members().filter(function(e) {
    return e.isEnemy() && e._isMinionEsporo && !e.isAlive();
  });

  if (deadMinions.length > 0) {
    var minion = deadMinions[0];
    minion.appear();
    minion.setHp(minion.mhp);
    minion._buffs = [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0];
  } else {
    console.log('WARNING: Nenhum minion morto encontrado para reviver!');
  }
</JS Post-Apply>
